csw:Record.dct:abstract:
The Western Australia (WA) Perth Canyon 500m North Mooring (IMOS code WACANO) was deployed in January 2010, and decommissioned in July of that year.
Data is downloaded from instruments on the mooring. Parameters collected are Temperature.
